description: The site's true-cost calculator: for a price on Kiawah, Seabrook or Johns Island, the buyer's closing costs, the first year of owning (property tax, association dues, base utilities), what comes later and the seller's side — each line from the fee ledger with how sure it is. An estimate from published fees, not a closing statement or tax advice.

area.description: Johns Island only: unincorporated county, inside the City of Charleston, or Kiawah River

club.description: Seabrook only: the Seabrook Island Club membership level

use.description: primary = the buyer's legal residence (4% assessment); second = second home or rental (6%)
